preconditions.description: The number of days m must be between 1 and 50.
The number of stores n must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n - 1 for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each day, the number of integers Dora bought must be between 1 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= store_index <= n for store_index in all_stores)
preconditions.description: All store indices must be valid, between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: Output 'possible' if there exist positive integers a_i such that Dora beats Swiper on every day.
Output 'impossible' if no such positive integers a_i exist.
